scope: Lighting navigation for the AULA F75 redesign

designDirection.appearance: Graphite studio with a restrained pale lime accent
retain: Icons-only navigation with accessible names and tooltips
Compact playback controls without live-status badges

tabs.label: Automatic
tabs.purpose: Self-running animations organized into effect families.

tabs.label: Typing
tabs.purpose: Lighting driven by key presses, holds, releases and typing patterns.

tabs.label: Screen
tabs.purpose: Lighting driven by colors from a display or selected screen region.

tabs.label: Per-key
tabs.purpose: Static key colors and selected keyboard zones.

tabs.label: Layers
tabs.purpose: Combine effects with separate controls for each layer.

tabs.label: System activity
tabs.purpose: Visualize computer activity using supported system telemetry.

organizationRules: Treat shapes, directions, palettes and similar variations as effect parameters rather than separate effect families.
Keep themes such as Nature, Space and Retro as collections within relevant modes.
Keep System activity as a first-class Lighting tab.
Determine which telemetry sources are available during implementation; this approval does not assert that a particular sensor is currently supported.
implementationStatus: All seven lighting modes and six application workspaces are implemented. Windows portable EXE and ZIP are packaged; packaged native smoke passes.

implemented: Icons-only app and lighting-mode navigation; all seven approved modes retained
Entire Automatic catalog: 72 families containing 116 renderers, with related versions grouped
Independent catalog scrolling with fixed preview and independently scrolling inspector on desktop
Hover and keyboard-focus thumbnail animation; offscreen suspension and reduced-motion support
Effect-specific engine parameter schemas, normalized presets, and runtime engine editing
Version-specific controls; only supported renderers expose travel settings
Brightness and palette adjustments, search, favorites, and browser-local presets
Play, pause, stop, paused edits, and motion-rate changes without phase jumps
Earlier studio presets migrate to the new family and parameter model
Typing: 8 families / 15 curated renderers with engine parameters, scoped test pad, clickable keyboard, and a demo sequence
Audio: spectrum, bass pulse, waveform, and frequency zones; generated sample input, shared/tab audio, and microphone capture
Screen: chosen display or labeled sample scene; spatial, average, and edge mapping with crop, saturation, and exposure
Per-key: selection, zones, paint, erase, undo/redo, palettes, and validated color import/export
Layers: up to 12 layers with 116 effect choices, contextual parameters, masks, blend modes, opacity, order, duplicate/delete, and continuous rate edits
System activity: real CPU and physical memory readings, history, meters/heat/zones, warning colors, and explicit manual sample inputs
All six added modes persist their settings locally; capture permissions and active streams never auto-restore
Capture cleanup covers stop, source changes, mode navigation, denied inputs, missing audio, and delayed picker results
Key mapping: both firmware layers, visual selection, local persistence, reset, and explicit flash writes
Macros: scoped recording, down/up/delay timeline, editing, visual simulation, import/export, and duplicate/delete
Profiles: complete seven-mode setups, mapping layers, macros and preferences; import/export, rename, duplicate, apply and update
Games: 14 existing engines with hover previews, focused controls, play/pause/restart, speed and persistent high scores
Settings and Advanced: connection, explicit lighting output, persistent quality/density, Windows startup/tray preferences, update checks, key tester, bounded logs and snapshots
Windows: shared StudioRuntime in main process, global key hook, native telemetry, system audio, chosen-screen capture, frame preview IPC, tray playback and restore
browserStudio.hardwareStatus: Wired F75 RGB colors and correct-key typing ripples confirmed by user. Automatic output and native system-audio capture exercised. Valid onboard lighting configuration matches before/after. Key mapping remains inconclusive; selected-display capture and physical audio response need user verification.
validation: Web, shared engine, and desktop TypeScript checks
ESLint for studio components, library, and browser tests
Full unit suite, including per-parameter visible-change and valid-frame checks for all 116 renderers
Browser tests: full-catalog scrolling, fixed preview, icon navigation, hover/focus, reduced motion, playback, parameters, presets, and four viewport sizes
2867 unit tests passed, including curated typing parameters, audio silence/controls, pixel sampling, per-key colors, blend/mask/clock behavior, telemetry mapping, and persistence parsing
Automatic browser regression passed after the six new modes were added
Six-mode browser interaction suite passed at 1440, 1280, 768, and 390 pixel widths
Capture tests use actual Web Audio / MediaStream / canvas video fixtures, including microphone, missing audio, cancellation, and delayed navigation cleanup
280 scoped studio unit checks passed, plus Windows engine-host regression checks
New-workspace browser smoke passes: full profile restoration, mapping layers, macros, all 14 games, preferences and key testing at four viewport sizes
Electron smoke passes: all workspaces, painted keyboard canvas, global hook start, native CPU/memory, and virtual RGB frames; zero physical HID writes
The broader repository suite currently has failures in the separately developed expansion effects; see test-results/studio/unit-results.json
Curated collection audit: all 116 renderer signatures differ across six sampled times; related renderers stay grouped as variations
Packaged Windows smoke passes with all six additional workspaces, painted preview, actual global hook startup, telemetry, and virtual RGB output

Physical wired F75: user-confirmed RGB/WASD and correct-key typing; native loopback capture; validated unchanged lighting configuration. Twenty regression checks pass for native typing counters and feature-reply validation. Updated packaged Windows smoke passes.

previousProblems: Six tiles did not demonstrate the full-library browsing experience.
Generic direction mirrored finished frames rather than controlling the renderer.
The inspector did not reflect the selected effect and version.
Live-status dots, repeated preview labels, and a wide text sidebar added clutter.
An oversized preview crowded the catalog on a small laptop.
remaining: Firmware macro upload remains unsupported; macros record, edit, export, and simulate locally.
Experimental expansion effects are excluded from the studio until their separate engine validation and artistic review pass.
Key remapping, physical audio response, and selected-display capture still need conclusive hands-on verification.

systemTelemetry.sampling: One sample per second, independent of HTTP request frequency

approval: User requested adding System activity to the proposed six-tab navigation and locking the set.
